links.comparator_used: Full coverage, with the model outputting a prediction for every case (no abstention)
links.outcome: Accuracy among retained cases under resolution shift (GI endoscopy)
links.effect: Accuracy 0.683 at full coverage to 0.852 (95% CI 0.835-0.871) at 25% coverage; balanced accuracy 0.646 to 0.798
links.tradeoff: Only 25% of cases are automated at the best reported accuracy, and the rest are deferred to human review. Discrimination is not improved, and prospective validation is still required.
links.quote: Selective prediction improved reliability among retained cases: under resolution shift, accuracy rose from 0.683 at full coverage to 0.852 (95% CI 0.835-0.871) at 25% coverage (balanced accuracy 0.646 → 0.798).

links.comparator_used: Uncalibrated model probabilities under resolution shift
links.outcome: Calibration (expected calibration error) under acquisition shift
links.effect: ECE 0.172 to 0.036 with temperature scaling and to 0.017 with isotonic regression
links.tradeoff: Recalibration does not recover discrimination, and residual confident-wrong predictions remain, so selective prediction is still needed.
links.quote: Target-domain recalibration substantially restores calibration under shift (ECE 0.172 → 0.036 with temperature scaling; → 0.017 with isotonic regression) but does not recover discrimination; selective prediction is complementary, mitigating residual confident-wrong predictions.
